text: The Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia organises the Saudi Cup meeting at King Abdulaziz Racecourse, Riyadh; the 2026 card carried presenting partners Qiddiya City (1351 Turf Sprint, $2m), Saudi National Bank (Riyadh Dirt Sprint, $2m), Howden (Neom Turf Cup, $3m), Longines (Red Sea Turf Handicap, $2.5m), ZOOD Realty (Saudi Derby, $1.5m) and SHG (Tuwaiq Cup, $1m), with the $20m Saudi Cup itself unsponsored.
short: Saudi Cup 2026 race presenters: Qiddiya City, SNB, Howden, Longines, ZOOD Realty, SHG
